effect.fr: Tenu: Change Silvallié dans sa forme Eau.  Change le type de Coup Varia-Type en Eau.
effect.en: Held: Changes Silvally to its Water form.  Changes Multi-Attack’s type to Water.

flavor.ko: 물타입의 데이터가 들어 있는 메모리. 특정 포켓몬이 지니면 타입이 바뀐다.
flavor.en: A memory disc that contains Water-type data. It changes the type of the holder if held by a certain species of Pokémon.
